headline: Former Amazon HR leader to drive people strategy at Wakefit Innovations
summary: Wakefit Innovations has appointed former Amazon HR Director Suman Yadav as its Chief Human Resources Officer, effective October 2026. Yadav brings extensive leadership experience across military operations, corporate HR roles at Infosys BPM and Amazon, and strategic HR advisory. In her new role, she will oversee Wakefit's people and culture agenda as the D2C home solutions company continues to scale.

headline: Flipkart faces employee morale concerns amid IPO uncertainty and senior exits
summary: Walmart-owned Flipkart is experiencing growing employee frustration and senior-level departures due to uncertainty surrounding its initial public offering timeline. Although the e-commerce giant has conducted over $1.5 billion in stock buybacks since 2017, employees remain concerned about realizing the full value of their equity options without a formal listing. Flipkart maintains that an IPO remains part of its strategic roadmap and will proceed when the timing is appropriate.

headline: From McKinsey talent strategy to CHRO: Shweta Govil Singh joins Shriram Farm Solutions
summary: Shweta Govil Singh has been appointed as Chief Human Resources Officer at Shriram Farm Solutions, a business unit of DCM Shriram. She brings over two decades of HR experience across multiple sectors, including a 14-year tenure in global talent strategy and leadership development at McKinsey & Company. Her appointment marks a transition from global consulting talent management to a comprehensive business CHRO role.

headline: HR Perspectives by Sharad K. Sharma: “We try to keep emotion out of people decisions”
summary: Sharad K. Sharma, CHRO of Pramerica Life Insurance, addresses high frontline sales attrition by focusing heavily on an employee's first 90 days of onboarding. By implementing structured cohort training, data-driven attrition analysis, and active field feedback, the company aims to drive early sales success and improve manager effectiveness. Additionally, Pramerica balances external hiring with internal talent development programs like SOAR to build a robust future leadership pipeline.

headline: Scripbox to certify client-facing managers in financial planning
summary: Indian wealth-management firm Scripbox has partnered with a personal finance platform to certify its relationship and engagement managers through the six-month Qualified Personal Finance Professional (QPFP) program. The training covers core financial planning, cash-flow management, client engagement, and the responsible integration of artificial intelligence in wealth advisory. The initiative aims to upskill Scripbox's team to deliver comprehensive, goal-oriented financial guidance rather than focusing solely on individual investment products.

headline: Tata Chemicals opens safety training centre for employees and partners
summary: Tata Chemicals has launched 'Suraksha Gurukul', a dedicated safety training facility at its Mithapur site designed to enhance safety skills among employees, contractors, and drivers. The center integrates virtual reality, driving simulators, and practical demonstrations to help workers recognize hazards and practice emergency responses in a controlled environment. This initiative supports the company's broader Zero Harm program aimed at fostering a proactive safety culture across its operations.

headline: Hero MotoCorp turns to industrial HR veteran Nikhil Diwan
summary: Hero MotoCorp has appointed industrial HR veteran Nikhil Diwan as its new head of human resources. Diwan brings over 23 years of experience managing workforce operations and industrial relations across heavy industries, having previously served in key leadership roles at Aarti Industries, Vedanta Resources, and Reliance Industries. His extensive manufacturing-focused HR background will now support Hero MotoCorp's expanding automotive and electric mobility operations.

headline: Shalu Sood moves up the HR leadership ranks at JSW Energy
summary: Shalu Sood has been promoted to Vice President of Corporate HR, Talent & Strategic Initiatives at JSW Energy, continuing her steady leadership progression at the company since 2021. In her elevated role, she oversees corporate HR, organization design, talent management, and M&A integration. Sood brings over two decades of human resources experience across diverse industries including energy, technology, telecom, and pharmaceuticals.

headline: 28 years across factories and workforces: Atul Pandey takes HR charge at Victory Group
summary: Atul Pandey has been appointed as the Group Human Resources Director at Victory Group, bringing nearly 28 years of HR experience across manufacturing and industrial sectors. Throughout his career, he has held senior HR leadership roles at companies such as Aamor Inox, SFC Solutions, Samsung India, and Cargill India, specializing in workforce relations and HR transformation. In his new position, Pandey will drive Victory Group's strategic HR agenda, focusing on organizational development and workforce management.
